title: My joint pain is gone
review: Thanks to this app I am able to exercise at home and have lost all pain in my knees and hip and I feel better during the days I have done it. The simplicity of this app is appealing and now with the updates I am able to keep track of my progress and it's cool to see how just 4 and 5 months ago I was exercising 2-3 days this month 20 days already! Love it
author: BH1BH

title: I love the app
review: Overall, great workout! Just a few suggestions: A couple of the exercises only target one side, so it would be great to include both sides to ensure balanced training. Also, there seems to be some exercise time used to prepare for active rest. Consider reducing the active rest periods and adding that time back into the exercises to keep the workout more engaging and effective.
author: Kenolovestommy

title: Very Helpful App
review: Of all the apps over the years, this is one that I keep coming back to. It's straightforward, uplifting and only seven minutes! It combines aspects of strength and flexibility and can easily be fit into a daily routine. There are only a few sequences to choose from, but sometimes simplicity is best.
author: Ruth@21#

title: Calm & Move
review: I have to say, I was putting this off for more high intensity workouts. But, am really impressed with how great I feel after going through just the first 7 minutes. I think I'm going to start doing it 5 total times now including my regular workouts. Thank you.
author: rfff7116

title: Time for relaxation
review: As a full time teacher, part time grad student, wife of a veteran and mother of a beautiful daughter, taking the time to relax is essential for stress management. This is a simple 7 minutes out of my day! How great is that?! Who can't squeeze in 7 minutes? Very calm narration and simple instructions. Easy to follow.
author: Mercedes Lobo

title: The best way to start the day
review: I have been doing at least 7 minutes every morning. This is a great discipline to clear your mind and start the day free of clutter. On each breath say Thank You, do that for a week and you will surely notice a positive change in your daily life.
author: Nelvis77

title: Perfect for relaxing before bed
review: This is a great set of motions to help me relax before I go to bed. The only thing I can think of for improvement is a little explanation of how to move before I start. I am learning as I go but I'm not sure if I'm moving the way I should or not. Would recommend!
author: Mike-stl

title: Great way to boost digestion
review: I use this practice to stabilize my blood sugar after meals and keep my HRV levels consistent.However, I think there's a bug. Sometimes though it removes the session from the calendar if I don't do the same type of session or do it twice in one day.
author: paharper

title: Soothing Activation
review: I have used 7 minute chi as wast to activate my body in the mornings or afternoons or relax in preparation for sleep. It's the right amount of time to soothe my mind and body before my day, at night, or between workouts. It also alerts my to areas where im not flexible after injuries.
author: Andy Tunes

title: Love it! But 2-for-1 failed
review: Latest: still love the app, but I paid for the 2-for-1 special and it only gave me 1 of the 2. The other one (sleep well) wants me to pay again. I didn't mind the cost in general, it's just annoying not to get what you pay for. As a newbie to tai chi, this is an excellent intro. As someone who lacks patience, I'm excited to try more of the sessions, but it's probably best I stick with this for now.
author: Deb d1
